name: Archaics
description: Beings provoked into a destructive rampage who confront the school and students.

description_citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around 4565 AR the archaics become erratic and tensions reignite between Silkmeadow and Tor-Kathorr over All-Gleam.
timeline.quote: many of the normally gentle archaics became erratic and incensed, randomly attacking others on the plane

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Archaics become erratic and rampage across the plane, and Jadzi seeks the cause.
timeline.quote: Currently, many of the normally gentle archaics have become erratic and incensed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen wakes in the titan's hollow to find six archaics gathered around a snarl of magic and chanting.
timeline.quote: six enormous figures, each with too many limbs undulating in time, sat gathered around a thick snarl of magic—archaics.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The archaics notice Lluwen sketching and stop, and he flees up a vine while their chant grows louder.
timeline.quote: Lluwen didn't need to be told twice.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi explains that archaics are oracles flung back in time after death, and that this archaic is the last.
timeline.quote: Archaics are oracles, like I am.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The archaics rampaged, and worse followed.
timeline.quote: In the wake of the archaics' rampage, much worse was to come.

citation.text: Tragedy Feaster (Secrets of Strixhaven Promos, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Archaics, provoked into a destructive rampage, confront the school and the students.
timeline.quote: The school and the students are confronted by the Archaics

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fel combs Titan's Grave for solutions and takes interest in the Archaics.
timeline.quote: He took particular interest in the Archaics

citation.text: "Dellian Fel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
